Hyperphagia -> Obesity -> Insulin Secretion > IGF-1 Receptor > Growth

He then starts explaining changes of diet. Increases of sugar/fructose etc. Then whips out the differences between HFCS vs sucrose. Basically sucrose breaks down into more glucose which basically every organ in body can use + a little fructose. HFCS breaks down more into fructose. Fructose binds more quickly to protein, fructose doesn't suppress ghrelin, fructose doesn't stimulate insulin in fact leads to insulin resistance. Fructose doesn't go into glycogen. Leads to fatty liver + higher triglycerides
